newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Beximco, Hyatt plan 5-star hotel.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Beximco, Hyatt plan 5-star hotel.

text.p: Bangladesh's Beximco group and Hyatt International Corporation of the United States will build a $225 million five-star hotel in Dhaka, Beximco officials said on Monday.
They said Beximco had already acquired 3.82 acres (1.52 hectares) of land in the heart of the Bangladesh capital to construct the 250-room hotel.
Beximco and Hyatt International Corp, the U.S. hotel chain, have reached a deal whereby each group will hold equity of 40 percent and 60 percent respectively in the project, the officials said.
The officials said the hotel complex would comprise three or four towers built on a 4-5 storey podium. The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may be housed in one of the towers, they said.
The Beximco group, the country's largest conglomerate, owns 25 companies of which 12 are listed on the DSE.
Construction of the hotel will begin next year. There are now only two five-star hotels in the country, including the Dhaka Sheraton Hotel.
